components.name: Lily-stem glazed rail
components.function: Human-height glazed barrier variation for palace/garden terraces; use separate simple collision rail in game.
components.construction: Two slender ivory lily stems rise symmetrically from low rose-marble sill, curling gold leaves brace the stems. Three emerald/mint glass lobes sit behind the stems; no flower planters or repeated star medallions. One straight repeat with small end posts. Removable thin glass behind the structural tracery. Both post backs/ends have plain mounting seats. No floor slab, stairs or attached wall.
components.attachment_face: Underside of sill/end posts to terrace edge; flat post-side seats join next repeat
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
components.component_family: Glazed parapet designs and twelve-colour glass palette
components.notes: Four distinct glazed railing patterns and all twelve labelled colour samples appear. Marble/gold vocabulary remains consistent with GEN-39; green, aqua, purple and amber glass provide new palette variation. Swatches are faceted material illustrations, not gem meshes or measured PBR transmission samples. Material IDs are kept separately from the four structural asset IDs. End posts and glass-seat sketches do not prove cross-compatibility with existing corner/stair rails. Some small front/contact views change ornament proportions; establish actual matching profiles before instancing. Source backs, dimensions, repeat patterns, inter-view parity and physical attachment remain unverified. Whole-sheet generation does not prove individual meshes are separable.
